headline: Weathered Expanse Aflame; Wardens Take Ground at Passage
war_summary: The heaviest fighting of the day has moved to the Weathered Expanse, where the ledger now reads one Warden work, five Colonial and three unclaimed, a change from the seven Colonial posts and two unclaimed works reported at noon. Forty-five events were filed there in the past day, nine within the last two hours, and the latest at 2:58 this afternoon; the day's casualty roll there stands near five thousand nine hundred Colonial and nine thousand six hundred Warden, the war's steepest toll. Callahan's Passage remains the second furnace, nine Warden works against one unclaimed, with twenty-eight events in the day and eight in the last two hours, the latest at 3:16. Palantine Berm, scene of thirty-three events in the day, has fallen quiet these past two hours, as has the Nevish Line, holding six Warden to two Colonial and silent since mid-morning. Stlican Shelf reports four events in six hours, eight Colonial works to one Warden, while Mooring County's twelve Warden works drew six events in the day and Stlican's Briar remains the busiest single post. No victory has been declared.
